'''Asami Seto''' (Japanese: '''瀬戸麻沙美''' ''Seto Asami'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Seto was born on April 2, 1993, in {{wp|Saitama Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She first voiced [[Nanette]], a [[character of the day]] who appeared during {{aniseries|BW}}. She then landed a recurring role as [[Officer Jenny]] in the [[Alola]] [[region]] in the {{aniseries|SM|''Sun & Moon'' series}}. Hirose is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|Sigma Seven}}.
